description: Records containing at least one rare categorical level
evidence: 523 levels below 188 rows across 39 categorical fields; 14721 distinct source rows affected.
handling_decision: Retain source values; fit any rare-level pooling or encoding on training folds only and verify unseen-level behavior.
likely_impact: Small groups can yield unstable target summaries and poorly estimated encoded effects.

description: Categorical fields with one level above 99% share
handling_decision: Retain the fields for reproducibility; assess incremental value during validation and avoid conclusions driven by tiny minorities.
likely_impact: Near-constant predictors may add little signal and make minority-level target comparisons unstable.

description: Numeric fields with absolute skewness above 1
handling_decision: Preserve raw values; use robust summaries and compare raw-loss relationships with log1p-loss relationships.
likely_impact: Means, Pearson correlations, and fitted objectives may be disproportionately influenced by the upper tail.

description: Row-field observations outside 1.5 x IQR fences
handling_decision: Treat as distribution-tail evidence, not errors; do not delete or clip without model-validation evidence.
likely_impact: Tail observations may increase sensitivity of averages, correlations, and fitted models.

description: Predictors with quantile bins reduced by tied edges
evidence: cont2: 9 of 10 bins; cont5: 8 of 10 bins
handling_decision: Use qcut with duplicates='drop', retain the actual bin count, and verify that every source row is assigned.
likely_impact: The affected predictors have fewer comparison groups than requested, but no observations are lost.

description: Categorical fields lacking two supported levels for comparison
evidence: cat15: 1 supported of 2 observed levels; cat22: 1 supported of 2 observed levels; cat55: 1 supported of 2 observed levels; cat56: 1 supported of 2 observed levels; cat62: 1 supported of 2 observed levels; cat63: 1 supported of 2 observed levels; cat64: 1 supported of 2 observed levels; cat68: 1 supported of 2 observed levels; cat70: 1 supported of 2 observed levels
handling_decision: Retain all level summaries but do not make strong target-relationship claims where fewer than two levels meet the support threshold.
likely_impact: Apparent target differences are driven by sparse groups and are not reliable for field-level interpretation.
